summary: La Rosa Holdings Corp. filed an 8-K to report the issuance of the remaining 250 shares of Series D Convertible Preferred Stock to an institutional investor for $250,000 aggregate proceeds, completing a previously disclosed private placement under Regulation D Rule 506(b). The issuance followed the filing of the company's Form 10-K and does not represent a change-of-control, buyout, or special situation event. This is a routine capital-raising transaction with no impact on corporate governance or strategy.
